text: execute_phase ![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/90101521-5fd2-4984-a15c-7078e8ddb283) * 被[uvm_phase::m_run_phases]()调用 * 先等待前面的 phase 执行完，之后检查跨 domain 的 phase 的同步 * 用于标识一个 phase 的执行情况，是已经执行完了还是根本没有执行还是正在执行，初始化时候将 uvm_domain 设置成 uvm_phase_dormant 的状态 ```systemverilog local uvm_phase_state m_state; ``` * 调用[phase_state_change]()，这个函数定义在回调函数类中，默认为空，如果有需要在phase 转换的过程中需要的操作可以添加到这个函数中 * 如果当前节点不是普通节点(uvm_domain/uvm_schedule) * 状态转换: UVM_PHASE_DORMANT ➡️ UVM_PHASE_SYNCING ➡️ UVM_PHASE_STARTED ➡️ UVM_PHASE_EXECUTING ➡️ UVM_PHASE_DONE ➡️ UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULED(successor) * 不真实执行 phase 而是直接虚拟执行，跳转到执行状态 * 运行结束之后直接进入到 UVM_PHASE_DONE 状态，判断是否还有后继节点，如果有就将他们设置成 UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULED 状态并依次添加到 m_phase_hopper 中 * 如果当前节点是普通节点(uvm_phase) * 状态转换: UVM_PHASE_DORMANT ➡️ UVM_PHASE_SYNCING ➡️ UVM_PHASE_STARTED ➡️ UVM_PHASE_EXECUTING ➡️ UVM_PHASE_READY_TO_END ➡️ UVM_PHASE_DONE ➡️ UVM_PHASE_ENDED ➡️ UVM_PHASE_CLEANUP * 通过当前节点的静态实例指针 m_imp 来调用其 [uvm_topdown_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2012%3A%20uvm_topdown_phase.md)/[uvm_bottomup_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2050%3A%20uvm_bottomup_phase.md)/[uvm_task_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2035%3A%20uvm_task_phase.md) 函数，将所有的component 的状态设置成 UVM_PHASE_STARTED。 * 如果当前 phase 不是 UVM_PHASE_TASK，则通过[uvm_topdown_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2012%3A%20uvm_topdown_phase.md)/[uvm_bottomup_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2050%3A%20uvm_bottomup_phase.md) 函数，将所有的component 的状态设置成 UVM_PHASE_EXECUTING。 * 如果是 UVM_PHASE_TASK，则通过[uvm_task_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2035%3A%20uvm_task_phase.md)并行执行所有component 的 phase，因为 task phase 需要消耗时间，所有采用 fork...join_none，跳过等待，直接进入到监控结束仿真程序 * condition1: jump * 判断 [end_prematurely]() 中设置的 jump_flag * condition2: wait for drop * 判断是不是有 objection 被 raise 起来了。假如对于当前的 phase，没有任何 objection 被 raise 起来，那么将会直接跳到 else 分支，并最终会退出 fork...join_any * 如果有 raise objection，则需要调用[uvm_objection:wait_for](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2051:%20uvm_objection.md) 传入[uvm_object_globals:uvm_objection_event](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2010:%20uvm_object_globals.md#uvm_objection_event) 等到所有的 objection drop，因为当前的 component 是 uvm_root，**因此 phase 结束的条件是 uvm_root 的所有 objection 结束，并且只能是通过 phase_done 这个 objection 来 raise 的objection 才会被等待** * condition3: timeout * 只对 task phase 有 timeout 检查，对于 function phase 直接跳过 * 默认 [uvm_global_defines:UVM_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/02%3A%20uvm_macros/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_global_defines.md) 9200s * 可以通过 [uvm_globals:set_global_timeout](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2001:%20uvm_globals.md) 函数来设置 timeout，这里的 timeout 是设置给 uvm_top * 以上三个条件任意一个被满足意味着可以结束当前的 phase，则进入到结束流程中: * 检查是否要 jump，如果需要则更新 target phase * ENDED: 更新当前 phase 状态到 UVM_PHASE_ENDED * CLEANUP: 对 objection 进行 [uvm_objection:clear]() * DONE: 如果是 jump 则调用 [clear_successors]() * SCHEDULED: 如果有跳转则将 target phase 重新加入到队列中，如果没有则将后继节点加入到执行队列中 * 如果当前 phase 不是 UVM_PHASE_TASK，则通过[uvm_topdown_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2012%3A%20uvm_topdown_phase.md)/[uvm_bottomup_phase:traverse](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2050%3A%20uvm_bottomup_phase.md) 函数，将所有的component 的状态设置成 UVM_PHASE_ENDED。 * 最后，在当前 phase 完全结束之后，会将其后继节点全部添加到运行队列中，假设此时是 start_of_simulation_phase，那么此时它有三个后继者，一是 run_phase，二是 m_uvm_domain，三是新加入的 domain [uvm_component:set_domain]()。 前面说过，m_uvm_domain 的 pre_reset_phase 其实会和 run_phase 在同一时刻被 fork 起来执行，同样的，新加入的 domain 的 pre_reset_phase 也会在这一时刻被 fork 起来执行。不过新的 domain 的 pre_resset_phase 不必和 m_uvm_phase 的 pre_reset_phase 同步，二者不必相互等待对方完成，这就是新建 domain 的优势所在。 ```systemverilog task uvm_phase::execute_phase(); uvm_task_phase task_phase; uvm_root top; uvm_phase_state_change state_chg; uvm_coreservice_t cs; cs = uvm_coreservice_t::get(); top = cs.get_root(); // If we got here by jumping forward, we must wait for // all its predecessor nodes to b
title: execute_phase

text: uvm_domain * uvm_domain是从uvm_phase继承而来的。**这里对uvm_domain的理解可以认为是用来隔离不同的uvm_component在run-time phase的phase域**，而run_phase和各个function phase在不同的uvm_component始终是保持同步的。如下图所示两个不同的domain中的driver的run-time phase是可以不同步的。 * m_common_domain 中存放正常运行时所有的 phase，包括各种函数 phase，run_phase 及 12 个动态运行时的 phase * m_uvm_domain 中存放的是一个 uvm_phase 类型的变量 m_uvm_schedule，而这个变量中存放着 12 个动态运行时的 phase * m_uvm_schedule 存放的是 12 个动态运行的 phase * m_domains 则用于记录所有的 uvm_domain 信息 ```systemverilog class uvm_domain extends uvm_phase; static local uvm_domain m_common_domain; static local uvm_domain m_uvm_domain; // run-time phases static local uvm_domain m_domains[string]; static local uvm_phase m_uvm_schedule; ``` ---

text: uvm_phase_type * 被 [uvm_phase](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2007:%20uvm_phase.md) 调用 ```systemverilog typedef enum { UVM_PHASE_IMP, UVM_PHASE_NODE, UVM_PHASE_TERMINAL, UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULE, UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN, UVM_PHASE_GLOBAL } uvm_phase_type; ``` * uvm_phase类自身及其所有派生类例化出来的对象，都拥有一个属性叫m_phase_type。这个属性用来表示当前对象的类别，不同的类别在UVM的Phase机制中意味着有不同的作用。 * **UVM_PHASE_IMP**: 指的就是类似于 uvm_build_phase，uvm_connect_phase 等一些单实例的 phase，这些phase只拥有单一对象，且都会实现exec_func或exec_task的方法用来调用用户定义在环境组件(uvm_component)中的各种xxxx_phase函数或者任务 * **UVM_PHASE_NODE**: Node节点对象跟实现类比较容易混淆。节点是用来构成有向无环图的基本元素。节点对象包含一个重要的成员变量m_imp，该成员变量引用某一个实现类对象(IMP object)。也就是说，如果你有多个Phase域，那么在每个Phase域中都可以存在指向同一个实现类对象的节点。它的含义是图形结构中的某一个节点，它是一个句柄，它自己不干具体的活(比如main phase具体要干什么) * **UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULE**: Schedule对象包含了一组节点，以及这些节点的连接关系，所以它也可以看成是Phase域的子集。Schedule对象通过这些节点和连接关系来表征Phase的执行顺序。它的含义和UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN相同，**唯一的区别就是它不具有独立行动的权利**，它的外面至少需要套一层UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN；形象点说，UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN可以代表整个图形结构或者代表某个子图结构，但是，UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULE则只能代表某个子图结构，它必须属于某个DOMAIN，也就是它必须被某个DOMAIN wrap起来！**例如我们源代码中run_time phase相关的12个节点就被调用add_uvm_phases()添加到了m_uvm_schedule中，然后m_uvm_schedule又被添加到了m_uvm_domain中，m_uvm_domain又被添加到了m_common_domain中** * **UVM_PHASE_TERMINAL**: 代表一个 schedule 中的终结 node。这是一个比较特殊的类别，专门用来表示图中最末尾的节点，它没有什么其他大的作用。在代码实现上，在构造有向无环图的过程中，可以通过识别该节点来插入前序需要执行的节点。 * **UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN**: 这是一个比较特殊的类别，专门用来表示图中最末尾的节点，它没有什么其他大的作用。在代码实现上，在构造有向无环图的过程中，可以通过识别该节点来插入前序需要执行的节点。它是用来标定UVM_PHASE_DOMAIN和UVM_PHASE_SCHEDULE的势力范围的！就是说我后面的节点就不是你们的管辖范围了，只有一个domain或者schedule才有这个东西。 * **UVM中Phase机制的执行遵循一张图。这里的“图”，就是图论中的有向无环图，有节点有连接有方向。每一个Phase域拥有一张图（图中的节点需要add进去），图的每一个节点引用一个实现类对象，节点之间的有向连接表示这些实现类对象被处理的顺序。这里的“处理”指的是完成一轮Phase状态的跳转，在不同Phase状态下调用该节点m_imp引用的实现类对象中对应的函数。参与仿真的环境组件都会属于某一个Phase域，默认的Phase域为common_domain，其中的节点会在调用get_common_domain的时候自动添加。** ---

text:
🗽 chapter 14: uvm_report_object

![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/fa022b67-928b-4f64-abda-5291e9956116)


* Purpose: 
  * It serves as a base class for components that need reporting capabilities in UVM.

* Structure:
  * It extends uvm_object.
  * Each instance has its own uvm_report_handler (m_rh), allowing for component-specific report configurations.

* Key Methods:
  * Report functions: uvm_report_info, uvm_report_warning, uvm_report_error, and uvm_report_fatal.
  * uvm_report: The core method called by all specific report functions.
  * uvm_process_report_message: Processes and sends report messages to the handler.

* Verbosity Control:
  * Methods to get and set verbosity levels for different severities and IDs.
  * uvm_report_enabled: Checks if a report should be processed based on verbosity settings.

* Action Control:
  * Methods to get and set actions for different severities and IDs.
  * Actions determine how reports are handled (e.g., displayed, logged, counted).

* File Handling:
  * Methods to set and get file handles for report output.

* Severity Overrides:
  * Allows overriding the severity of messages based on current severity or ID.

* Max Quit Count:
  * Sets the maximum number of errors before simulation termination.

text:
uvm_report_info

* 被[uvm_globals:uvm_report_info](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2001:%20uvm_globals.md#uvm_report_info)调用
* 有两个版本，一个是属于 uvm_report_object 的，一个是[uvm_globals](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2001%3A%20uvm_globals.md)的，而全局的最终会调用 uvm_root 即 uvm_report_object 的这个函数

```systemverilog
  virtual function void uvm_report_info( string id,
					 string message,
					 int verbosity = UVM_MEDIUM,
					 string filename = "",
					 int line = 0,
    					 string context_name = "",
					 bit report_enabled_checked = 0);

    uvm_report (UVM_INFO, id, message, verbosity, 
                filename, line, context_name, report_enabled_checked);
  endfunction
```
* 只有uvm_report_info中verbosity可以通过参数传入，其他函数都是在使用默认参数

text:
chapter 15: uvm_report_handler

* Purpose
  * Manages the reporting configuration for UVM components
  * Controls how messages are processed and displayed

* Structure
  * Extends `uvm_object`
  * Uses associative arrays to store configuration settings for:
    * Different severities
    * IDs
    * Actions

* Key Properties
  * `m_max_verbosity_level`: Sets the maximum verbosity level
  * Arrays for storing:
    * Verbosity settings
    * Actions
    * Severity overrides
    * File handles

* Initialization
  * The `initialize` function sets up default behaviors for different severities

* Message Processing
  * Core method: `process_report_message`
    * Handles report messages
    * Applies severity overrides
    * Sets up the message for further processing

* Verbosity Control
  * Methods include:
    * `get_verbosity_level`
    * `set_verbosity_level`

* Action Control
  * Methods include:
    * `get_action`
    * `set_severity_action`

* File Handling
  * Methods include:
    * `get_file_handle`
    * `set_default_file`

* Severity Overrides
  * Allows dynamic changing of message severities based on:
    * ID
    * General severity

text:
get_verbosity_level

* 存在着与 severity 相对应的记录 -> key: uvm_severity  / value:uvm_id_verbosities_array - stores verbosity levels for specific combinations of severity and message ID

```systemverilog
uvm_id_verbosities_array severity_id_verbosities[uvm_severity];
```

* severity_id_verbosities 是这样的一个联合数组:它的索引是 uvm_severity(整数型)，而其内容则是一个 uvm_object，在这个 object 中有着一个联合数组，这个联合数组的索引是 string 类型的，而内容则是整数类型的。

```systemverilog
typedef uvm_pool#(string, int) uvm_id_verbosities_array;
```

* 保存id和对应的verbosity，可以在同一个object的不同phase使用不同的id对verbosity级别进行精细化管理 - stores verbosity levels for specific combinations of severity and message ID

```systemverilog
uvm_id_verbosities_array id_verbosities;
```

* 被[uvm_report_object:get_report_verbosity_level](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/edit/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2014%3A%20uvm_report_object.md)调用

* 这个函数用来检查当前环境中对 verbosity level，用于和语句中对 verbosity level 比较，以确定是否要对当前语句进行处理，具体的查找过程分为三步:
 
  * 先检查对于当前的 severity level，是否有对于当前 id 的 verbosity 设置
  * 再检查是否对当前 id 设置了 verbosity
  * 如果都没有，则返回当前 object 的 `m_max_verbosity_level`， 默认`m_max_verbosity_level = UVM_MEDIUM`，可以通过命令行进行修改

```systemverilog
function int get_verbosity_level(uvm_severity severity=UVM_INFO, string id="" );

  uvm_id_verbosities_array array;
  
  // 先检查针对于当前severity，是否有对当前id设置了特殊verbosity
  if(severity_id_verbosities.exists(severity)) begin
    array = severity_id_verbosities[severity];
    if(array.exists(id)) begin
      return array.get(id);  // Return the specific verbosity level for this severity and id
    end
  end

  // 检查是否对当前id 设置了verbosity
  if(id_verbosities.exists(id)) begin
    return id_verbosities.get(id);  // Return the verbosity level for this id
  end

  // If no specific settings found, return the default maximum verbosity level
  return m_max_verbosity_level;

endfunction
```

text:
🗽 chapter 16: uvm_report_server

* Purpose:
  * Manages global reporting settings and statistics
  * Acts as a centralized point for processing and handling report messages

* Structure:
  * uvm_report_server is a virtual class extending uvm_object
  * uvm_default_report_server is the concrete implementation

* Key Features:
  * Singleton pattern: Only one instance exists globally
  * Manages quit count and maximum quit count
  * Tracks severity counts and ID counts
  * Handles message recording and database management

* Important Methods:
  * set_server and get_server: Manage the global server instance
  * process_report_message: Core method for handling report messages
  * execute_report_message: Performs actions based on message settings
  * Various methods for managing quit count, severity count, and ID count

* Customization:
  * Allows setting a custom report server to replace the default one

* Message Processing:
  * Handles message recording, display, and logging
  * Manages actions like UVM_DISPLAY, UVM_LOG, UVM_COUNT, UVM_EXIT, and UVM_STOP

* Statistics:
  * Keeps track of message counts by severity and ID
  * Provides methods to retrieve and reset these counts

text:
🗽 chapter 18: uvm_coreservice

* uvm_coreservice_t (Virtual Base Class):
  * This is a virtual class that defines the interface for core UVM services.
  * It includes a static get() function to retrieve the singleton instance.

* uvm_default_coreservice_t (Concrete Implementation):
  * This class extends uvm_coreservice_t and provides the default implementation of core UVM services.
  * It manages several key UVM components as singleton instances:
    * UVM Factory
    * UVM Root
    * Transaction Database
    * Report Server
    * Component Visitor

* Key Methods:
  * get(): Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of the core service.
  * get_root(): Returns the UVM root instance.
  * get_factory(): Returns (and creates if necessary) the UVM factory instance.
  * set_factory(): Allows setting a custom factory.
  * get_default_tr_database(): Returns (and creates if necessary) the default transaction database.
  * set_default_tr_database(): Allows setting a custom transaction database.
  * get_report_server(): Returns (and creates if necessary) the report server instance.
  * set_report_server(): Allows setting a custom report server.
  * set_component_visitor() and get_component_visitor(): Manage the component visitor for traversing the UVM component hierarchy.

* Singleton Pattern:
  * The class uses the singleton pattern to ensure only one instance of the core service exists.
  * This is implemented using a static inst variable and the get() method.

* Lazy Initialization:
  * Many of the getter methods use lazy initialization, creating the objects only when first requested.

* Customization Points:
  * The setter methods allow users to customize key UVM services by providing their own implementations.

* Default Implementations:
  * The class provides default implementations for all core services, ensuring UVM can function out-of-the-box.

text:
uvm_status_container

* The uvm_status_container class in UVM is a crucial component for managing and storing the state of various automation methods. Here's a summary of its key features and functionalities:

1. Purpose:
   - Stores the state of automation methods used in UVM.
   - Provides a centralized location for storing and accessing various types of data and flags used during UVM operations.

2. Key Components:
   - Flags: Stores boolean flags for various states (e.g., warning, status).
   - Data Storage: Holds different types of data (e.g., bitstream, integers, strings, objects).
   - Policy Objects: Contains references to policy objects for compare, pack/unpack, record, and print operations.
   - Scope Management: Includes a uvm_scope_stack for managing hierarchical scopes.
   - Cycle Checking: Implements cycle detection in data structures.

3. Important Fields:
   - clone: Flag for controlling cloning behavior.
   - bitstream: For storing packed/unpacked data.
   - object: For storing object references.
   - field_array: Static array to track fields across all instances.
   - print_matches: Static flag to control printing of matching fields.
   - cycle_check: Map for detecting cycles in data structures.

4. Policy Objects:
   - comparer: For compare operations.
   - packer: For pack/unpack operations.
   - recorder: For recording operations.
   - printer: For print operations.

5. Key Methods:
   - do_field_check: Checks for duplicate field definitions.
   - get_function_type: Returns string representation of UVM operation types.
   - m_do_cycle_check: Implements cycle detection logic.

6. Scope Management:
   - Uses uvm_scope_stack for hierarchical scope tracking.
   - Provides methods for manipulating and accessing the scope stack.

7. Cycle Detection:
   - Implements a mechanism to detect and prevent infinite recursion in data structures.
   - Uses m_uvm_cycle_scopes queue and cycle_check associative array.

8. Utility Functions:
   - get_full_scope_arg: Returns the full scope as a string.

```systemverilog
class uvm_status_container;
  // The clone setting is used by the set/get config to know if cloning is on
  bit             clone = 1;

  // Information variables used by the macro functions for storage
  bit             warning;            // Indicates if a warning occurred
  bit             status;             // General status flag
  uvm_bitstream_t bitstream;          // Bitstream for packing/unpacking
  int             intv;               // Integer value storage
  int             element;            // Element index for arrays
  string          stringv;            // String value storage
  string          scratch1;           // Temporary string storage
  string          scratch2;           // Additional temporary string storage
  string          key;                // Key for associative arrays
  uvm_object      object;             // Object reference storage
  bit             array_warning_done; // Flag to prevent repeated array warnings

  // Static array to track fields across all instances
  static bit field_array[string];

  // Flag to control printing of matching fields
  static bit print_matches;

  // The scope stack is used for messages that are emitted by policy classes
  uvm_scope_stack scope = new;

  // Used for checking cycles in data structures
  // When a data function is entered, if the depth is non-zero, 
  // then the existence of the object in the map means that a
  // cycle has occurred and the function should immediately exit. 
  // When the function exits, it should reset the cycle map to prevent memory leaks.
  bit cycle_check[uvm_object];

  // These are the policy objects currently in use
  // The policy object gets set when a function starts up. The macros use this.
  uvm_comparer    comparer;  // For compare operations
  uvm_packer      packer;    // For pack/unpack operations
  uvm_recorder    recorder;  // For recording operations
  uvm_printer     printer;   // For print operations
```

text:
do_field_check

* 将所有在当前 class 中使用了 field automation 的变量名放入 field_array 中。
* 被[uvm_object_defines:uvm_field_int](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/edit/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/02%3A%20uvm_macros/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_object_defines.md)调用，在class实例化的时候检查每一个field

* 因此在做完 [uvm_component:build_phase](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2006:%20uvm_component.md) 之后，所有被加入到 field_automation 的变量都会被加入到 field_array 中
* 每一个 component 会在调用完成 [uvm_component:apply_config_settings](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2006:%20uvm_component.md) 之后，将数组清空

```systemverilog
function void do_field_check(string field, uvm_object obj);
 `ifdef UVM_ENABLE_FIELD_CHECKS                                           
  if (field_array.exists(field))
    //report error if register 2 same variables within one class
    uvm_report_error("MLTFLD", $sformatf("Field %s is defined multiple times in type '%s'",
       field, obj.get_type_name()), UVM_NONE);
  `endif
  field_array[field] = 1;
endfunction
```

text:
compare_field

* compare_field vs compare_field_int:
  - Similar functionality
  - compare_field_int: handles data up to 64 bits
  - compare_field: handles data up to 4096 bits

* Purpose: Compare bitstreams up to 4096 bits

* Operation:
  * If size <= 64 bits: delegate to compare_field_int
  * For larger sizes:
    * Create mask based on size
   b. Compare masked values of lhs and rhs
   c. If different:
      - Format message based on specified radix (binary, octal, decimal, etc.)
      - Use print_msg to report mismatch

* Key feature: Efficient handling of large bitstreams

```systemverilog
virtual function bit compare_field (string name, 
                                    uvm_bitstream_t lhs, 
                                    uvm_bitstream_t rhs, 
                                    int size,
                                    uvm_radix_enum radix=UVM_NORADIX); 
  uvm_bitstream_t mask;
  string msg;

  if(size <= 64)
    return compare_field_int(name, lhs, rhs, size, radix);

  mask = -1;
  mask >>= (UVM_STREAMBITS-size);
  if((lhs & mask) !== (rhs & mask)) begin
    uvm_object::__m_uvm_status_container.scope.set_arg(name);
    case (radix)
      UVM_BIN: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'b%0b : rhs = 'b%0b", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_OCT: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'o%0o : rhs = 'o%0o", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_DEC: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0d : rhs = %0d", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_TIME: begin
          $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0t : rhs = %0t", 
             lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
      end
      UVM_STRING: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0s : rhs = %0s", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_ENUM: begin
            //Printed as decimal, user should cuse compare string for enum val
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0d : rhs = %0d", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
            end
      default: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'h%0x : rhs = 'h%0x", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
    endcase
    print_msg(msg);
    return 0;
  end
  return 1;
endfunction
```

text:
compare_field_int

* 通过size来控制对低几位进行比较，可以通过radix来控制进制

* mask 其值是根据 size 的值来判断的，假如 size=5，那么可以计算出 mask 的值为 64’b11111。
* 根据这个 mask 的值，从而会只比较要比较的两个数的低 5 位，而把高位忽略。这输入的两个数据不一样时，根据输入的参数决定以什么进制来输出这两个数字，可以有二进制，十进制，十六进制甚至还可以是字符串形式。
  
* Purpose: Compares integer fields up to 64 bits.
* Operation:
  - Creates a mask based on the specified size.
  - Compares the masked values of lhs and rhs.
  - If different, formats a message based on the specified radix.
  - Uses print_msg to report mismatches.
* Key feature: Efficient for smaller integer comparisons.


```systemverilog
virtual function bit compare_field_int (string name, 
                                        uvm_integral_t lhs, 
                                        uvm_integral_t rhs, 
                                        int size,
                                        uvm_radix_enum radix=UVM_NORADIX); 
  logic [63:0] mask;
  string msg;

  mask = -1;
  mask >>= (64-size);
  if((lhs & mask) !== (rhs & mask)) begin
    uvm_object::__m_uvm_status_container.scope.set_arg(name);
    case (radix)
      UVM_BIN: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'b%0b : rhs = 'b%0b", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_OCT: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'o%0o : rhs = 'o%0o", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_DEC: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0d : rhs = %0d", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_TIME: begin
          $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0t : rhs = %0t", 
             lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
      end
      UVM_STRING: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0s : rhs = %0s", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
      UVM_ENUM: begin
            //Printed as decimal, user should cuse compare string for enum val
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = %0d : rhs = %0d", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
            end
      default: begin
            $swrite(msg, "lhs = 'h%0x : rhs = 'h%0x", 
                     lhs&mask, rhs&mask);
           end
    endcase
    print_msg(msg);
    return 0;
  end
  return 1;
endfunction
```

text:
uvm_resource_pool

* uvm_resource_pool，基类，资源池，uvm_resource通过set操作可将其加入到uvm_resource_pool中，uvm_resource_pool中的resource全局可见，uvm中各组件、部分都可以到该资源池中通过get_by_name/type对resource进行取用。需要注意的是，各resource的标签（scope）是存放在个resource内部的，而非uvm_resource_pool中， uvm_resource_pool仅存放各resource read/write访问历史记录，在仿真任意阶段都可以打印查看该历史记录。

* uvm_resource_pool类自成一体，没有继承自任何类型。其静态函数get()返回该类型在全局的唯一实例。主要储存资源的数据类型是两个联合数组 **rtab[]** 和 **ttab[]**，二者分别以字符串类型的name和uvm_resource_base类型的type为索引，储存内容为uvm_resource_types类中的静态uvm_queue类型的rsrc_q_t，也就是说我们可以通过name或者type为索引将一笔uvm_resource #(T)类型的资源分别存入以name/type为索引的队列rsrc_q_t中，很明显，以同一name为索引的这个队列也可以存入不同type的其它资源(他们的name是相同的)，同理以同一type为索引的队列中也可以存入不同name的其它资源(他们的type是相同的)

```systemverilog
class uvm_resource_pool;

  static local uvm_resource_pool rp = get();
  get_t get_record [$];  // history of gets
```
* key: string, value: [uvm_resource_types:rsrc_q_t](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2024%3A%20uvm_resource_types.md)队列
* rtab 中的不同的 queue 中存放的 uvm_resource_base 的名字是不一样的，同一 queue 中存放的名字是一样的，这个名字就是 queue 的索引。

```systemverilog
uvm_resource_types::rsrc_q_t rtab [string];
```

* key:[uvm_resource_base](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2025%3A%20uvm_resource_base.md), value: [uvm_resource_types:rsrc_q_t](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2024%3A%20uvm_resource_types.md)队列
* ttab 中不同 queue 存放的 uvm_resource_base 的类型是不一样的，这里的类型主要体现在由其派生而来的 uvm_resource#(type T)中的 T 是不一样的。同一 queue 中存放的类型是一样的。


text:
uvm_port_component_base

* 此类定义了一个接口，用于在 end_of_elaboration 阶段之后或期间获取端口的连接列表。子类 uvm_port_component #(PORT) 实现了这个接口。
* 连接列表以此类对象的句柄形式返回。 这允许通过递归调用 get_connected_to 和 get_provided_to 遍历任何端口的扇出和扇入网络。 可以使用从 uvm_component 继承的 get_full_name 和 get_type_name 方法检索每个端口的全名和类型名称。

```systemverilog
virtual class uvm_port_component_base extends uvm_component;
```

* 被[uvm_component:do_resolve_bindings](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2006%3A%20uvm_component.md)调用，这个函数用来梳理 port 之间的关系，对于普通的 component 这个函数是一个空实现，之后对于当前的这种类型，调用了绑定 port 的对应函数进行梳理

  ![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/25159e5a-1951-4c98-9149-0492ab8d4b26)
  
* 调用与其对应的 port 的 [uvm_port_base:resolve_bindings](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2029%3A%20uvm_port_base.md)。因此，每一个 port 内部的 resolve_bindings 是会自动被调用的。
```systemverilog
virtual function void resolve_bindings();
  m_port.resolve_bindings();
endfunction
```

text: 🗽 chapter 29: uvm_port_base * Purpose: * uvm_port_base is a fundamental class in UVM for implementing TLM (Transaction-Level Modeling) ports. * It serves as the base class for various types of UVM ports, exports, and implementations. * Key Features: * Supports different port types: UVM_PORT, UVM_EXPORT, UVM_IMPLEMENTATION. * Manages connections between ports, exports, and implementations. * Provides methods for connection validation and resolution. * Offers debugging utilities to visualize port connections. * Important Properties: * m_if_mask: Indicates which TLM interfaces are implemented. * m_port_type: Specifies the type of port (UVM_PORT, UVM_EXPORT, UVM_IMPLEMENTATION). * m_min_size and m_max_size: Define connection constraints. * m_provided_by and m_provided_to: Store connection information. * m_imp_list: Stores resolved implementation ports. * Key Methods: * connect(): Establishes connections between ports. * resolve_bindings(): Resolves port connections and updates the implementation list. * debug_connected_to(): Visualizes the fanout network of the port. * debug_provided_to(): Visualizes the fanin network of the port. * Various utility methods like is_port(), is_export(), is_imp(), etc. * Connection Validation: * Checks for valid port types and hierarchical relationships during connections. * Ensures that connected ports have compatible interface masks. * Debugging Support: * Provides detailed visualization of port connections for debugging purposes. * Supports limiting the depth of connection display for complex hierarchies. * Integration with UVM Components: * Works closely with uvm_port_component to represent ports within the UVM component hierarchy.

m_show_msg

* 在调用 [uvm_config_db:set](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2032%3A%20uvm_config_db.md)/[uvm_config_db:get]()等函数时时，这些函数最后会判断 [uvm_config_db_options:is_tracing](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2032%3A%20uvm_config_db.md) 的返回值，若为1则调用这个函数把当前操作的细节打印出来
  
```systemverilog
protected static function void m_show_msg(
        input string id,
        input string rtype,
        input string action,
        input string scope,
        input string name,
        input uvm_object accessor,
        input rsrc_t rsrc);

        T foo;
        string msg=`uvm_typename(foo);

        $sformat(msg, "%s '%s%s' (type %s) %s by %s = %s",
            rtype,scope, name=="" ? "" : {".",name}, msg,action,
            (accessor != null) ? accessor.get_full_name() : "<unknown>",
            rsrc==null?"null (failed lookup)":rsrc.convert2string());

        `uvm_info(id, msg, UVM_LOW)
endfunction
```

text:
uvm_callback

* 可以通过对这个类进行扩展得到实际需要的 callback
```systemverilog
class uvm_callback extends uvm_object;

  static uvm_report_object reporter = new("cb_tracer");

  protected bit m_enabled = 1;
```

* 进行扩展

```systemverilog
class driver_callback extends uvm_callback;
     function new(string name = "driver_callback");
          super.new(name);
     endfunction: new
  
     virtual task pre_send(driver drv, transaction tr);　　　//这是注入错误的
     endtask
  
     virtual task post_send(driver drv, transaction tr);　　//这是用来收集覆盖率的
     endtask
endcalss: driver_callback
```

* 具体实现

```systemverilog
class driver_error_callback extends driver_callback;
     virtual task pre_send(driver drv, transaction tr);
          drv.req.payload.delete()
     endtask: pre_send
endclass: driver_error_callback
```

text:
callback_mode

* 被[uvm_callbacks:first](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2039%3A%20uvm_callbacks.md)调用

* 通过控制 m_enabled 功能，那么可以暂时的让某个 callback 失效

  ```systemverilog
  my_cb.callback_mode(0);
  ```
  
* 如果输入的参数为-1，那么就返回 m_enabled 的值，如果输入的为 0 或 1，那么就表示让 m_enabled 的值为 0 或 1。也就是说这个函数还有设置 m_enabled 功能。

  ![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/f57d691e-ed91-411e-8416-f98517b038c9)


```systemverilog
function bit callback_mode(int on=-1);
  if(on == 0 || on == 1) begin
    `uvm_cb_trace_noobj(this,$sformatf("Setting callback mode for %s to %s",
          get_name(), ((on==1) ? "ENABLED":"DISABLED")))
  end
  else begin
    `uvm_cb_trace_noobj(this,$sformatf("Callback mode for %s is %s",
          get_name(), ((m_enabled==1) ? "ENABLED":"DISABLED")))
  end
  callback_mode = m_enabled;
  if(on==0) m_enabled=0;
  if(on==1) m_enabled=1;
endfunction
```

text:
uvm_callbacks_base

* 单实例化设计，其中定义了两个static变量，都是全局共享
* m_pool: key -> 绑定callback的object, value -> object绑定的所有callback
* m_super_type 在 []() 中设置，记录当前 class 的父类，所有父类的 callback 会自动被继承调用
* m_derived_types: 保存所有继承当前类callback的子类的`m_typeid`

| Parameter | Type | Element Type | Created in | Elements Added in | Used in | Meaning & Usage |
|-----------|------|--------------|------------|-------------------|---------|-----------------|
| m_pool | uvm_pool | uvm_queue#(uvm_callback) | uvm_callbacks_base | uvm_callbacks::add | uvm_callbacks::m_get_q | Global pool to store and manage callbacks for each object instance |
| m_this_type | queue | this_type | uvm_callbacks_base | uvm_callbacks::get | uvm_callbacks_base::check_registration | Stores different callback types for a specific object type, used for type checking and registration |
| m_super_type | uvm_typeid_base | N/A | uvm_callbacks_base | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | uvm_callbacks_base::check_registration | Holds the Type ID of the superclass, used for inheritance checking in callbacks |
| m_derived_types | queue | uvm_typeid_base | uvm_callbacks_base | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | uvm_typed_callbacks::m_get_tw_cb_q | Stores derived class types for callback inheritance, enabling polymorphic callback behavior |
| m_tw_cb_q | uvm_queue | uvm_callback | uvm_typed_callbacks | uvm_typed_callbacks::m_add_tw_cbs | uvm_callbacks::m_get_q | Stores and manages type-wide callbacks for a specific type T |
| m_typename | string | N/A | uvm_typed_callbacks | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | uvm_typed_callbacks::display | Stores the name of type T, used for display, debugging, and type identification |
| m_t_inst | this_type | N/A | uvm_typed_callbacks | uvm_typed_callbacks::m_initialize | uvm_typed_callbacks::m_add_tw_cbs | Singleton instance for type-specific operations, ensuring a single point of control for each type |
| m_typeid | uvm_typeid_base | N/A | uvm_callbacks | uvm_callbacks::get | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | Holds the Type ID for T, used for type checking and registration in the callback system |
| m_cb_typeid | uvm_typeid_base | N/A | uvm_callbacks | uvm_callbacks::get | uvm_callbacks::m_is_for_me | Holds the Type ID for CB (callback), used for callback type checking and validation |
| m_base_inst | uvm_callbacks#(T,uvm_callback) | N/A | uvm_callbacks | uvm_callbacks::get | uvm_callbacks::add | Base instance of callbacks, used for managing base callback operations and type-wide callbacks |
| m_d_inst | this_type | N/A | uvm_derived_callbacks | uvm_derived_callbacks::get | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | Singleton instance for derived callbacks, used for type-specific operations in derived classes |
| m_user_inst | this_user_type | N/A | uvm_derived_callbacks | uvm_derived_callbacks::get | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | Instance of user-defined callback type, used for user-specific callback operations and customization |
| m_super_inst | this_super_type | N/A | uvm_derived_callbacks | uvm_derived_callbacks::get | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | Instance of superclass callback type, used for superclass callback operations and inheritance management |
| m_s_typeid | uvm_typeid_base | N/A | uvm_derived_callbacks | uvm_derived_callbacks::get | uvm_derived_callbacks::register_super_type | Holds the Type ID of the superclass, used for type checking and inheritance management in derived classes |


```systemverilog
class uvm_callbacks_base extends uvm_object;
  
  typedef uvm_callbacks_base this_type;
  
  /*protected*/ static bit m_tracing = 1;                        // Flag to enable/disable tracing of callbacks
  static this_type m_b_inst;                                     // Singleton instance of uvm_callbacks_base
  static uvm_pool#(uvm_object,uvm_queue#(uvm_callback)) m_pool;  // Pool to store callbacks for each object
  
  //Type checking interface
  this_type       m_this_type[$];     // Queue of callback types for this object type (one-to-many T->T/CB)
  uvm_typeid_base m_super_type;       // Type ID of the superclass (one-to-one relation)
  uvm_typeid_base m_derived_types[$]; // Queue of type IDs for derived classes (one-to-many relation)
```

text:
m_is_registered

* 重写uvm_callbacks_base中的方法，被[uvm_callbacks_base:check_registration](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2037%3A%20uvm_callbacks_base.md)调用。
* 调用[m_is_for_me]()检查callback的类型；调用[uvm_typed_callbacks:m_am_i_a](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2038%3A%20uvm_typed_callbacks.md)检查obj类型，这两者都必须和当前的callbacks创建时候使用的参数一致。如果参数是 null 则一定返回 true

  ![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/0071806f-bac4-4107-bcdb-fa7672a952ef)


```systemverilog
  virtual function bit m_is_registered(uvm_object obj, uvm_callback cb);
    if(
        m_is_for_me(cb) // 检查当前的callback是否和创建callbacks时使用的cb一致
        && 
        m_am_i_a(obj)   // 检查当前的obj是否和创建callbacks时使用的obj一致
      ) begin
      return m_registered;
    end
  endfunction
```

text:
m_get_q

![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/32538b22-ee75-4620-97ca-7162e97b3f82)

* 被 [get_first]() / [get_next]() 调用，返回一个包含所有 callback 的队列，这里的 obj 来自于 [uvm_callback_defines:uvm_do_callbacks](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/02%3A%20uvm_macros/chapter%2001%3A%20uvm_callback_defines.md) 传入的参数是 this，说明这里传入的是当前这个包含有 uvm_do_callbacks 类的一个实例
  
* 先检查[uvm_callbacks_base:m_pool](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2037%3A%20uvm_callbacks_base.md)中是否有对当前对象的callback信息，如果没有：
  * 如果当前变量是null，返回[uvm_typed_callbacks:m_tw_cb_q](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2038%3A%20uvm_typed_callbacks.md)中对类的callback
  * 如果当前变量不是null，调用[uvm_typed_callbacks:m_get_tw_cb_q](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2038%3A%20uvm_typed_callbacks.md)，说明当前的 inst 并没有对它的直接 obj 绑定信息，这里要遍历它的m_derived_types(?)，最后还是返回对类的 callback 队列
* 如果存在，则直接返回对当前对象的callback队列

```systemverilog
  static function void m_get_q (ref uvm_queue #(uvm_callback) q, input T obj);
    if(!m_base_inst.m_pool.exists(obj)) begin //no instance specific
      q = (obj == null) ? m_t_inst.m_tw_cb_q : m_t_inst.m_get_tw_cb_q(obj);
    end 
    else begin
      q = m_base_inst.m_pool.get(obj);
      if(q==null) begin
        q=new;
        m_base_inst.m_pool.add(obj,q);
      end
    end
  endfunction
```

title: 🗽 chapter 51:uvm_objection

text:
uvm_objection

* **m_source_count 用来记录当前 obj 自己 raise 的 objection 的个数**
* **m_total_count 用来记录自己以及子节点 raise 的所有 objection 的个数**
* 在[m_raise]() 中进行初始化/添加
* 在[m_drop]() 中进行减少
* 在[m_clear]() 中进行清空
* 在[m_forked_drain]() 中进行删除
  
```systemverilog
protected int     m_source_count[uvm_object];
protected int     m_total_count [uvm_object];

protected uvm_root m_top;
```

* 在执行 drain time 之前用来保存新创建的 process，如果在这个期间重新 raise objection，则直接 kill process
```systemverilog
local process m_drain_proc[uvm_object];
```

* m_scheduled_list:
  * This is a queue that stores uvm_objection_context_object instances.
  * It's used to keep track of objections that have been dropped and are scheduled for drain processing.
  * When an objection is dropped and its count reaches zero, a context object is created and added to this list.
  * Information stored: Objects that have dropped all objections but haven't started their drain process yet.

* m_forked_list:
  * Another queue storing uvm_objection_context_object instances.
  * It's used as an intermediate step between scheduling and forking the drain process.
  * Contexts are moved from m_scheduled_list to m_forked_list just before the drain process is forked.
  * Information stored: Objects that are about to start their drain process.

* m_drain_proc:
  * An associative array that maps uvm_objects to processes.
  * It stores the process handles for active drain processes.
  * Used to keep track of running drain processes and allows for killing them if needed (e.g., if an objection is raised again).
  * Information stored: Active drain processes for objects.

* Information transfer between them:
  * m_scheduled_list -> m_forked_list:
    * When a drain process is about to be forked, the context object is moved from m_scheduled_list to m_forked_list. This happens in the m_execute_scheduled_forks() task.
  * m_forked_list -> m_drain_proc:
    * After moving a context to m_forked_list, a drain process is forked for that context. The process handle is then stored in m_drain_proc, associated with the object from the context.
  * m_drain_proc cleanup:
    * After a drain process completes, its entry is removed from m_drain_proc.

* The overall flow is:
  * Objection dropped -> Add to m_scheduled_list
  * Ready to process -> Move to m_forked_list
  * Fork drain process -> Add to m_drain_proc
  * Drain complete -> Remove from m_drain_proc

```systemverilog
class uvm_objection extends uvm_report_object;
  // Register callbacks for this objection
  `uvm_register_cb(uvm_objection, uvm_objection_callback)

  // Configuration and state variables
  protected bit                      m_trace_mode;               // Trace mode flag
  protected int                      m_source_count[uvm_object]; // Count of objections raised by each object
  protected int                      m_total_count [uvm_object]; // Total count of objections for each object and its children
  protected time                     m_drain_time  [uvm_object]; // Drain time for each object
  protected uvm_objection_events     m_events [uvm_object];      // Events for each object
  /*protected*/ bit                  m_top_all_dropped;          // Flag indicating if all objections at top level have been dropped

  protected uvm_root                 m_top;                      // Reference to UVM root object
     
  static uvm_objection               m_objections[$];            // Queue of all objection instances

  // Pool of context objects for reuse
  local static uvm_objection_context_object m_context_pool[$];

  // Process or container for drain procedures
`ifndef UVM_USE_PROCESS_CONTAINER   
  local process                      m_drain_proc[uvm_object];
`else
  local process_container_c          m_drain_proc[uvm_object];
`endif

  // Lists and contexts for scheduled and forked objections
  local static uvm_objection_context_object m_scheduled_list[$];
  local uvm_objection_context_object m_scheduled_contexts[uvm_object];
  local uvm_objection_context_object m_forked_list[$];
  local uvm_objection_context_object m_forked_contexts[uvm_object];

  // Control flags
  protected bit                      m_prop_mode = 1;           // Propagation mode flag
  protected bit                      m_cleared;                 // Flag to check if objection count < 0
```

text:
m_propagate

* 被[m_raise]() 调用，得到obj的parent。对于一个component来说，其parent的概念比较清楚， 就是在其 new 函数中指定的 parent，但是对于一个 sequence 来说，这个 parent 指什其 parent 就是 sequencer
* 递归调用 [m_raise]()，此时传入的参数是 obj 和 obj_parent
* **这个函数会在 m_raise 中被反复调用，调用的意义在于找到 obj parent, 这样可以在所有 parent 中递归添加一条记录，直到找到 uvm_root**

```systemverilog
function void m_propagate (uvm_object obj,
                           uvm_object source_obj,
                           string description,
                           int count,
                           bit raise,
                           int in_top_thread);
  if (obj != null && obj != m_top) begin
    obj = m_get_parent(obj);
    if(raise)
      m_raise(obj, source_obj, description, count);
    else
      m_drop(obj, source_obj, description, count, in_top_thread);
  end
endfunction
```

text:
drop_objection

* 被[uvm_phase:drop_objection](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2007:%20uvm_phase.md#drop_objection) 调用

* **当一个 componenet 调用 drop_objection 后，后面还有其他的语句:**
  * 如果没有任何延时语句那么会执行完所有的语句，包括再次 raise objection 
  * 如果包含延时语句，那么取决于当前 component drop objection 之后，uvm_root 是否已经 drop 了所有的 objection，如果是那么延时语句以及之后都不会执行，如果还有其他的objection，何时结束取决于 uvm_root 什么时候 drop 了所有的 objection

* 执行完这个函数之后无论如何都不会立即结束，因为 all_dropped 事件在 all_dropped 中触发，而 all_dropped 的调用没有发生在这个函数中，而是发生在另外的监视进程中，所以无论如何都不会立即结束，起码非延时语句都可以执行，对于延时语句还取决于 drain time

* 调用[m_drop]()
```systemverilog
virtual function void drop_objection (uvm_object obj=null,
                                      string description="",
                                      int count=1);
  if(obj == null)
    obj = m_top;
  m_drop (obj, obj, description, count, 0);
endfunction
```

🗽 chapter 58: uvm_packer

![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/86c44626-4530-4643-838d-46c6f96e882d)
![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/0e30a5a9-0902-490f-8ec4-4c66c75f94d2)

* 所有的 pack 方法都是逐个 bit 读取输入的数据，将其保存在内部的 m_bits 中，所有的 unpack 都是从 m_bits 中的对应位置读取出数据并返回
* 根据大端和小端模式的不同，存储和读取数据的方向不同，但是如果想要读取正确的数据，两者必须匹配，大端模式下的读写都需要将高位变低位
* 如果在正常的操作流程中，对数据先打包再解包，则需要保证处理每一个 filed 的顺序相同，而且在打包和解包之间需要重置 count 指针
* **pack**
  * **小端模式就是先选中数组的第一个元素，从这个元素的 lsb 开始处理，大端模式就是先选中数组的最后一个元素，从这个元素的 msb 开始处理**
* **unpack**
  * **小端模式就是从m_bits的lsb开始逐个向 msb 方向处理，大端模式就是从m_bits的当前段msb开始逐个向当前段的 lsb 方向处理，但是输出数组都是从lsb开始存储**

* **如果逐个对field pack/unpack，无论是大端还是小端模式，内部都可以自动处理，所获取到的 unpacked 结果和 pack 结果是一致的，但是如果使用的是大端模式，在pack的时候传入的是数组，对数组中的所有元素同时 pack，那么这种情况下，数组中最后一个元素就被放入到了 m_bits 的最前端，这时候如果在 unpack 的时候分别单独 unpack 每一个元素，那么顺序就会发生变化，第一个 unpack出来的元素实际上是原来数组的最后一个元素，但是如果 unpack 数组整体， 则顺序是正确的**

text:
enough_bits

* Purpose: Checks if there are enough bits left to unpack a given size.
* Operation: Compares the remaining bits with the needed bits.
* Key feature: Prevents buffer overruns during unpacking.

```systemverilog
function bit uvm_packer::enough_bits(int needed, string id);
  if ((m_packed_size - count) < needed) begin
    uvm_report_error("PCKSZ",
        $sformatf("%0d bits needed to unpack %0s, yet only %0d available.",
                  needed, id, (m_packed_size - count)), UVM_NONE);
    return 0;
  end
  return 1;
endfunction
```

```systemverilog
                        type RSP=REQ) extends uvm_component;
```

text: m_set_sqr_sequence_id ```systemverilog protected int m_sqr_seq_ids[int]; ``` * 对于每一个 sequence，都有唯一的一个 id 与其对应。这个值将会和 sequencer_id 值一起做为一条记录插入到 m_sqr_seq_ids 中，同时把此值将会通过 set_sequence_id 函数作为 m_sequence_id 的值。 * 每一个 sequence 都维护着自己的一个数组，用来记录自己和每一个 sequencer 之间的关系，key: sequencer_id, val: 当前 sequence 在这个 sequencer 上挂载的 id(g_sequence_id)，每一个 sequencer 都有自己独一无二的 id(m_sequencer_id)，但是对于 sequence，只有一个全局变量 g_sequence_id，**因此 sequence 本身没有 id，只有在发生挂载时候，会被分配一个全局的临时 id(g_sequence_id)，所以当一个 sequence 被挂载到多个 sequencer的时候，就会被分配多个不同的 g_sequence_id，这些值被当作 value 保存在这个联合数组中** * 被[uvm_sequencer_base:m_register_sequence](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2003%3A%20uvm_sequencer_base.md)调用 * 调用[uvm_sequence_item:set_sequence_id](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_sequence_item.md)初始的时候是把 m_sequence_id 的值设置为-1，这就意味着还没有把此 sequence 注册到 sequencer 中。因为一旦注册之后，那么 m_sequence_id 的值将会是一个大于 1 的数字。每次发生挂载的时候都会分配一个新的数值，所以如果一个 sequence 和多个 sequencer 挂载，那么这个 sequence 的 m_sequence_id 就会被更新很多次。更新很多次的意义在于，可以在每一个 sequencer 的 m_sqr_seq_ids 中记录这个信息 ```systemverilog function void m_set_sqr_sequence_id(int sequencer_id, int sequence_id); m_sqr_seq_ids[sequencer_id] = sequence_id; set_sequence_id(sequence_id); endfunction ``` ---

* 第一个是uvm_sequencer_base类型的sequencer * 第二个是uvm_sequence_base类型的parent_sequence * 第三个是int类型的this_priority，指的是sequence的优先级 * 第四个是bit类型的call_pre_post，如果这个call_pre_post为1则执行pre_body和post_body，否则就不执行pre_body和post_body。 * 定义了[uvm_object_globals:uvm_sequence_state](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03:%20uvm_base/chapter%2010:%20uvm_object_globals.md)的枚举类型变量，CREATED 表示此 sequence 已经实例化，接下来从 PRE_START 一直到 POST_START 其实是代表 5 个不同的 task 或者 function:pre_start，pre_body，body， post_body，post_start 等。STOPPED 则是表示一种不正常的中止，FINISHED 表示正常的结束。 * 设置 priority 属性。假设有多个 sequence 同时启动，这几个 sequence 共用一个 sequencer，那么 sequencer 将会根据 priority 的特性选择把哪个 sequence_item 送给 driver。**设置的 priority 属性大于 100 的话会优先发送，小于 100 的话则会最后发送** * 调用 [uvm_sequence_item:set_item_context](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_sequence_item.md#set_item_context)， $${\color{red}设置 \space parent\\_sequence \space 和 \space m\\_seqeuncer \space 和 \space p\\_sequencer \space}$$ * 调用 [clear_response_queue]()，清空存放 driver 发送给 sequence 的 response * 调用[uvm_component:get_tr_stream/uvm_component:begin_tr/uvm_component:begin_child_tr](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/edit/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/03%3A%20uvm_base/chapter%2006%3A%20uvm_component.md#begin_tr) 返回一个句柄，此句柄代表这个唯一的 sequence 已经在系统中记录，开始启动。 * 调用[uvm_sequence_item:set_sequence_id](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_sequence_item.md)，m_sequence_id是定义在uvm_sequence_item类中的int类型变量，表示当前sequence的一个独一无二的id号 * 清空 m_seq_sqr_ids，这是一个定义在uvm_sequence_base类中的以int类型为索引的联合数组，其中 **储存的是当前sequence在某sequencer(每一个sequencer也会有一个id，作为索引)中所分配的id号(一个sequence可能对应多个sequencer，一个sequencer也可能被用于执行多个sequence)**。 * 如my_sqr1和my_sqr2的id号分别为1和2，my_sqr1可以执行my_seq1和my_seq2，分别给他们分配id为3和4，同时my_sqr2也可以执行my_seq1，给my_seq1分配id为5，则： * my_seq1.m_sqr_seq_ids[1] = 3 //索引为my_sqr1的id，值为其给my_seq1分配的id * my_seq1.m_sqr_seq_ids[2] = 5 //索引为my_sqr2的id，值为其给my_seq1分配的id * my_seq2.m_sqr_seq_ids[1] = 4 //索引为my_sqr1的id，值为其给my_seq2分配的id * get_starting_phase

```systemverilog
function uvm_phase get_starting_phase();
`ifdef UVM_DEPRECATED_STARTING_PHASE
   begin
      bit throw_error;

      if (starting_phase != m_set_starting_phase) begin
         if (!m_warn_deprecated_set) begin
            `uvm_warning("UVM_DEPRECATED", "'starting_phase' is deprecated and not part of the UVM standard.  See documentation for uvm_sequence_base::set_starting_phase")
            m_warn_deprecated_set = 1;
         end
         
         if (m_starting_phase_dap.try_set(starting_phase))
           m_set_starting_phase = starting_phase;
         else begin
            uvm_phase dap_phase = m_starting_phase_dap.get();
            `uvm_error("UVM/SEQ/LOCK_DEPR",
                       {"The deprecated 'starting_phase' variable has been set to '",
                        (starting_phase == null) ? "<null>" : starting_phase.get_full_name(), 
                        "' after a call to get_starting_phase locked the value to '",
                        (dap_phase == null) ? "<null>" : dap_phase.get_full_name(), 
                        "'.  See documentation for uvm_sequence_base::set_starting_phase."})
         end
      end

   end
`endif
   return m_starting_phase_dap.get();
endfunction : get_starting_phase
```

```systemverilog
      uvm_report_fatal("WAITITEMDONE", "Null m_sequencer reference", UVM_NONE);
    end
  m_sequencer.wait_for_item_done(this, transaction_id);
endtask
```

text:
put_base_response

* 被 [uvm_sequence:put_response]() 调用

* 这里会首先判断负责存放response的uvm_sequence_item类型的队列 response_queue 的大小，其大小由int型变量 response_queue_depth决定，默认值是8，若response_queue_depth的值是-1，表示该队列可以无限存放response，若当前队列未满，则向其中存入通过参数传入的response句柄

```systemverilog
protected uvm_sequence_item response_queue[$];
```

```systemverilog
  virtual function void put_base_response(input uvm_sequence_item response);
    if ((response_queue_depth == -1) ||
        (response_queue.size() < response_queue_depth)) begin
      response_queue.push_back(response);
      return;
    end
    if (response_queue_error_report_disabled == 0) begin
      uvm_report_error(get_full_name(), "Response queue overflow, response was dropped", UVM_NONE);
    end
  endfunction
```

text:
response_handler

* 在sequence中通过 [uvm_sequence:get_response](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_sequence.md) 来取得response 依赖于 [uvm_sequence:put_response](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_sequence.md) 把response放入response_queue[$]

* 若driver中response产生不及时，则 [sequence:get_response]()就会一直阻塞在那里，进而导致无法放下一笔transaction，而driver也会被阻塞在这里。
* 此时可以使用response_handler，将get_response()和put_response()的依赖性分开，在 [uvm_sequencer_param_base:put_response]() 中，若sequence调用get_use_response_handler()返回值为1，会直接执行response_handler()函数并返回，而不会再去sequence的put_response()函数，从而可以避免等待 response_queue 中的response。

* 函数[get_use_response_handler]()会返回变量m_use_response_handler的值，这是一个bit型变量，默认值是0，我们可以通过调用 [use_response_handler]() 把变量m_use_response_handler置为1，同时可以通过重载这个函数来处理每一笔response。
  
```systemverilog
  virtual function void response_handler(uvm_sequence_item response);
    return;
  endfunction
```

* 当打开response handler功能后，用户需要重载虚函数response_handler。此函数的参数是一个uvm_sequence_item类型的指针，需要首先将其通过cast转换变成my_transaction类型，之后就可以根据rsp的值来决定后续sequence的行为。

```systemverilog
virtual function void response_handler(uvm_sequence_item response);
    if(!$cast(rsp, response))
      `uvm_error("seq", "can't cast")
    else begin
      `uvm_info("seq", "get one response", UVM_MEDIUM)
      rsp.print();
    end
endfunction
```

text: m_update_lists * 把 m_lock_arb_size 的值为 1，表示有新的请求产生。说明仲裁队列arb_sequence_q有更新。 * 调用这个函数会改变 m_lock_arb_size 因此如果当前处于 [m_wait_for_available_sequence]() 的循环等待中，会跳出等待，这样会最终影响执行顺序，因此在 lock 中不会调用这个函数，而在 grab 会调用 * 有这么几种情况会被调用: * wait_for_grant: 有新的 request 被加入到仲裁队列中 * m_select_sequence: 有 request 获得仲裁胜利，得到 sequencer 的使用权，将其在仲裁队列中删除 * m_lock_req: 被 grab 调用，有新的 request 加入到仲裁队列的开始，并改变了仲裁顺序 * grant_queued_locks: 有新的 lock request 被加入到 lock_list 中 * m_unlock_req: 有 lock request 从 lock_list 中被删除 * remove_sequence_from_queues: 有 sequence 已经结束，但是并没有将它从仲裁队列中移除，调用这个函数强制移除 ```systemverilog function void uvm_sequencer_base::m_update_lists(); m_lock_arb_size++; endfunction ``` ---

text:
m_get_seq_item_priority

* 对 sequence 和 sequence item 都可以设置优先级，优先级设置在 sequence item 中时，优先级值会覆盖 sequence 的优先级值

  * 对于 sequence，在调用 [uvm_sequence_base:start]() 时设置优先级
  * 对于 sequence item，在调用 [uvm_sequence_base:start_item]() 时设置优先级

```systemverilog
function int uvm_sequencer_base::m_get_seq_item_priority(uvm_sequence_request seq_q_entry);
  // If the priority was set on the item, then that is used
  if (seq_q_entry.item_priority != -1) begin
    if (seq_q_entry.item_priority <= 0) begin
      uvm_report_fatal("SEQITEMPRI",
                    $sformatf("Sequence item from %s has illegal priority: %0d",
                            seq_q_entry.sequence_ptr.get_full_name(),
                            seq_q_entry.item_priority), UVM_NONE);
    end
    return seq_q_entry.item_priority;
  end
  // Otherwise, use the priority of the calling sequence
  if (seq_q_entry.sequence_ptr.get_priority() < 0) begin
    uvm_report_fatal("SEQDEFPRI",
                    $sformatf("Sequence %s has illegal priority: %0d",
                            seq_q_entry.sequence_ptr.get_full_name(),
                            seq_q_entry.sequence_ptr.get_priority()), UVM_NONE);
  end
  return seq_q_entry.sequence_ptr.get_priority();
endfunction
```

text:
lock

* 我们可以在sequence中调用lock()/grab()来获得sequencer的优先使用权并一直占有该sequencer，直到调用unlock()/ungrab()来解除独占权
* **lock 不会打乱正常仲裁的规则和逻辑，只不过当当前 sequence 在仲裁中获胜，取得了使用权之后，从下一轮开始到当前 sequence 结束，都是当前 sequence 或者使用权**
* lock 和 grab 都是调用 [m_lock_req]() 任务，**二者唯一的区别就是传入的第二个参数lock前者为1而后者为0**
* 在 m_lock_req 中会创建一个 uvm_sequence_request 实例，把request设置为SEQ_TYPE_LOCK类型，接下来若参数lock为1，则把该实例指针放到队列arb_sequence_q[$]最后，否则放在队列最前面并更新m_lock_arb_size的值。
* 这么做的区别在于
  * lock 操作需要等待当前sequence和其它先提起的所有请求的sequences执行完毕才轮到自己。
  * grab 操作只需要等待当前sequence执行完毕就会开始占有sequencer，不必等待其它先提起lock/grab请求的sequences。

* 如果一个 sequence 使用了 lock/grab，那当 lock/grab 生效的时候，其 child sequence 也可以获得 sequencer 的优先使用权，原因是在 [is_child]() 中判断了当前 sequence 和 lock_list 中 sequence 中的关系，但是根据传入的参数判断，如果 child sequence 获取了使用权，parent sequence 并不会自动获得

```systemverilog
task uvm_sequencer_base::lock(uvm_sequence_base sequence_ptr);
  m_lock_req(sequence_ptr, 1);
endtask
```

text:
grab

* grab 会打乱正常的仲裁逻辑，使得在下一次仲裁的时候，当前 sequence 立即获得 sequencer 的使用权，并保持到 sequence 结束
* 如果有多个 sequence 同时使用这个方法，那么它们同时会被选中，但是最终哪个获取到使用权，需要根据仲裁算法，在它们之间选择
  
```systemverilog
task uvm_sequencer_base::grab(uvm_sequence_base sequence_ptr);
  m_lock_req(sequence_ptr, 0);
endtask
```

text:
is_blocked

* 被 [grant_queued_locks/m_choose_next_request]() 调用
* 判断 lock_list 中的记录内容是不是由这个 sequence 或者此 sequence 的 parent_sequence 发出的。如果都不是，说明有其它的 sequence 提交了 lock 请求，此 sequencer 已经被其它的 sequence 锁定了，于是会直接返回 1。
* 有两种情况可以返回0(容许当前 sequence 获得 lock)
  * lock list 当前为空
  * 获得 lock 权的 sequence 是当前 sequence 或者其 parent sequence

* 调用 [is_child]() 判断传入的两个 sequence 是否存在继承关系

```systemverilog
function bit uvm_sequencer_base::is_blocked(uvm_sequence_base sequence_ptr);

  if (sequence_ptr == null)
    uvm_report_fatal("uvm_sequence_controller",
                     "is_blocked passed null sequence_ptr", UVM_NONE);

    foreach (lock_list[i]) begin
      if ((lock_list[i].get_inst_id() != 
           sequence_ptr.get_inst_id()) &&
          (is_child(lock_list[i], sequence_ptr) == 0)) begin
        return 1;
      end
    end

    //return 0 if locklist is empty
    return 0;
endfunction
```

text:
kill_sequence

* 被 [uvm_sequence_base:kill]() 调用，如果当前 sequence 已经挂载到了一个 sequencer 上，则在结束 sequence 之前要先清除掉已经发送过的请求
* 想要结束一个 sequence 需要进行两步，首先先调用 [remove_sequence_from_queues]() 将这个 sequence 发起的所有仲裁请求删除，再调用 [uvm_sequence_base:m_kill]() 重置这个 sequence 的状态并结束线程
* 这两个步骤的次序不能颠倒，因为在 [m_choose_next_request]() 中在进行仲裁之间要检查队列中的 sequence 是否还都有效，如果已经失效了会报错，因此需要先移出队列再将 sequence 设置成无效
  
```systemverilog
function void uvm_sequencer_base::kill_sequence(uvm_sequence_base sequence_ptr);
  remove_sequence_from_queues(sequence_ptr);
  sequence_ptr.m_kill();
endfunction
```

* 被[uvm_sequencer_param_base:put_response](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/c5d8b77aed0e8f6a8863d1464436625c0bb8a2d8/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/05%3A%20uvm_seq/chapter%2006%3A%20uvm_sequencer_param_base.md)调用，对于每一个 response item，找到其绑定的 sequence，调用这个方法，这说明了不同的 response item 会被放到对应的 sequence 中存储，而不是保存到一起

* 调用 [uvm_sequence_base:put_base_response]()，将 response item 放入到 response_queue
  
```systemverilog
virtual function void put_response(uvm_sequence_item response_item);
  RSP response;
  if (!$cast(response, response_item)) begin
    uvm_report_fatal("PUTRSP", "Failure to cast response in put_response", UVM_NONE);
  end
  put_base_response(response_item);
endfunction
```

uvm_seq_item_pull_port

* 调用[uvm_tlm_imps:UVM_SEQ_PORT](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md)

* 在 [uvm_driver]() 中使用，用来连接 driver 和 sequencer

```systemverilog
class uvm_seq_item_pull_port #(type REQ=int, type RSP=REQ)
  extends uvm_port_base #(uvm_sqr_if_base #(REQ, RSP));
  `UVM_SEQ_PORT(`UVM_SEQ_ITEM_PULL_MASK, "uvm_seq_item_pull_port")
  `UVM_SEQ_ITEM_PULL_IMP(this.m_if, REQ, RSP, t, t)
  bit print_enabled;
endclass
```

text: uvm_tlm_if_base * 这些函数在 [uvm_tlm_imps](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md) 被重写作为具体实现，具体实现一般都是调用所在的component中实现的对应方法。 * 这个类没有派生自任何类，在类的内部，定义了三类接口: * 第一类是阻塞性质的普通方法，put，get，peek，transport(T1,T2) * 第二类是非阻塞性质的普通方法，try_put，try_get，try_peek，nb_transport(T1,T2)，相应的还有 can_put，can_get，can_peek * 第三类是用于广播的 write，是属于 analysis 的，向所有连接的 port 写。这是一 个 function，而不是 task。而前两类所有的都是 task * **这里提供的所有方法都是 virtual 方法，所以在子类不可以使用同名方法但是添加不同参数** ```systemverilog virtual class uvm_tlm_if_base #(type T1=int, type T2=int); ``` ---

text:
item_done

* Indicates that the request is completed to the sequencer. Any <uvm_sequence_base::wait_for_item_done> calls made by a sequence for this item will return.

* driver 发送完一个 item 时，会调用 seq_item_port 的 item_done，而这个 item_done 实际上就是 uvm_sequencer 的 item_done。

* 首先从m_req_fifo试图拿到一个sequence_item，若成功则把其sequence_id和transaction_id分别赋值给m_wait_for_item_sequence_id和m_wait_for_item_transaction_id表示已经成功取到该sequence_id对应的这笔transaction

* 此时 [uvm_sequencer_base:wait_for_item_done]() 中的wait()语句被触发。若参数传入的item句柄不为null，则调用 seq_item_export.put_response()，最后再次仲裁队列中的lock请求。这里实际上调用的是 [uvm_sequencer_param_base:put_response]() 函数

  ![image](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/assets/66343787/dd8ce8b4-9ae5-4601-80cd-32f5a20094ea)

```systemverilog
virtual function void item_done(input T2 t = null);
  uvm_report_error("item_done", `UVM_SEQ_ITEM_FUNCTION_ERROR, UVM_NONE);
endfunction
```

* 被[uvm_*_imp](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_imps.md)调用

* 通常在实例化 TLM 的时候会传入当前对象作为参数，例如在 my_scoreboard 中把 my_imp 时进行实例化的时候，会对 m_imp 进行赋值

```systemverilog
function my_scoreboard::new(string name, uvm_component parent);

  my_imp = new(“my_imp”, this);
endfunction
```

* m_imp 其实指的就是此 IMP 所在的 component 的指针

```systemverilog
`define UVM_IMP_COMMON(MASK,TYPE_NAME,IMP) \

    super.new (name, imp, UVM_IMPLEMENTATION, 1, 1); \
    m_imp = imp; \
    m_if_mask = MASK; \
  endfunction \
  `UVM_TLM_GET_TYPE_NAME(TYPE_NAME)
```

text:
UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP

* 被[uvm_*_imp](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_imps.md)/[uvm_*_port](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_imps.md)调用
* 重写了[uvm_tlm_if_base:put](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_tlm_ifs.md)方法

* 实际使用的时候，macro 中对应位置的参数直接展开构成函数

```systemverilog
class my_component extends uvm_component;
  my_fifo fifo;  // Assuming my_fifo has a put() method

  `UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP(fifo, my_transaction, t)

  // ... rest of the class ...
endclass

class my_component extends uvm_component;
  my_fifo fifo;  // Assuming my_fifo has a put() method

  task put(my_transaction t);
    fifo.put(t);
  endtask

  // ... rest of the class ...
endclass
```

* 不同类型的端口传入的imp类型不同
  * 对于IMP类型端口，传入的是m_imp，指向当前所在的component，因此在component中必须实现put函数或者方法
    * 假如 my_scoreboard 中用的是 uvm_blocking_get_imp，那么就需要在 my_scoreboard 中预 先定义好一个 get，假如用的是 uvm_nonblocking_put_imp，那么就需要在 my_scoreboard 中预先定义好 try_put，try_get。
    * **对于 IMP 本身来说，它其实本身不具体任何端口的 处理特性，端口的行为完全取决于在 my_scoreboard 中定义的相关函数。**

  * 对于port和export类型的端口，传入的是this.m_if，指向当前端口所指向的第一个IMP类型的端口

```systemverilog
`define UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP(imp, TYPE, arg) \
  task put (TYPE arg); \
    imp.put(arg); \
  endtask
```

text:
uvm_blocking_put_port

* [UVM_PORT_COMMON](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md) 中定义了 new 函数，创建的时候需要设置 port 的类型
* [UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md) 中第一个参数都是this.m_if，**m_if 其实指的是连接到此 PORT 的 imp 的指针，先通过它找到 imp，再通过 imp 找到对应的component，执行对应的方法**
* 这里通过调用宏定义来实现对函数的重写，原始空函数在[uvm_tlm_if_base](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2002%3A%20uvm_tlm_ifs.md)中
* 这个参数在调用[uvm_port_base:resolve_bindings](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md)的时候将m_if指向的当前端口所对应的第一个IMP类型端口

```systemverilog
class uvm_blocking_put_port #(type T=int)
  extends uvm_port_base #(uvm_tlm_if_base #(T,T));
  `UVM_PORT_COMMON(`UVM_TLM_BLOCKING_PUT_MASK,"uvm_blocking_put_port")
  `UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP (this.m_if, T, t)
endclass 
```

chapter 06: uvm_exports

* [UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md)中第一个参数都是this.m_if
* 这个参数在调用[uvm_port_base:resolve_bindings](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md)的时候将m_if指向的当前端口所对应的第一个IMP类型端口

* **所有使用宏的地方都会使用传入的参数进行替换，再在当前的位置展开**

text:
🗽 chapter 07: uvm_imps

* [UVM_IMP_COMMON](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md) 中定义了 new 函数并赋值了m_imp，m_imp 指向所在的 component 的实例

* 通过第二个宏 [UVM_BLOCKING_PUT_IMP/UVM_BLOCKING_GET_IMP](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/10%3A%20uvm_tlm/chapter%2004%3A%20uvm_tlm_imps.md) 重载 put/set 函数，对于 uvm_*_imp 来说，它的本质上只是重载了 * 号对应的接口，这里的 * 可以是 nonblocking_put，blocking_get 等等

* 所谓的重载其实也很简单，**调用了 m_imp 的 put 函数。这也意味着，在 my_scoreboard 中必须要有一个 put 函数**

```systemverilog
uvm_blocking_put_imp #(mac_transaction, my_scoreboard) my_imp;
```

```systemverilog
class uvm_blocking_put_imp #(type T=int, type IMP=int)
  extends uvm_port_base #(uvm_tlm_if_base #(T,T));
  `UVM_IMP_COMMON(`UVM_TLM_BLOCKING_PUT_MASK,"uvm_blocking_put_imp",IMP)

endclass
```

text:
add_reg

* 在 [uvm_reg:configure](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/11%3A%20uvm_reg/chapter%2003%3A%20uvm_reg.md) 中，将 uvm_reg 添加到 uvm_reg_block 的时候调用

* 检测是否已经被 lock 住，被 lock 后是不能再向 uvm_reg_block 中加入 uvm_reg 的。
* 同一个 uvm_reg 不能多次添加到同一个 uvm_reg_block

* 向 regs 中插入一条记录，记录的索引是要加入的 uvm_reg，而记录的内容则是 id，id 是一个静态的变量，这表明所有的 uvm_reg_block 的实例共用这一个变量。 所以 id 的值就表示 register model 中所有已经加入到 uvm_reg_block 的 uvm_reg 的数量。
* ***id 表示在执行这句代码前已经加入到 register model 中的 uvm_reg，uvm_mem 和 uvm_reg_block 的数量之和。***
```systemverilog
local static int id;
```
  
```systemverilog
function void uvm_reg_block::add_reg(uvm_reg rg);
   if (this.is_locked()) begin
      `uvm_error("RegModel", "Cannot add register to locked block model");
      return;
   end

   if (this.regs.exists(rg)) begin
      `uvm_error("RegModel", {"Register '",rg.get_name(),
         "' has already been registered with block '",get_name(),"'"})
       return;
   end

   regs[rg] = id++;
endfunction: add_reg
```

text:
add_mem

* 被 [uvm_mem:configure](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/11%3A%20uvm_reg/chapter%2007%3A%20uvm_mem.md) 调用，将 uvm_reg_mem 添加到 uvm_reg_block 中

* 保证此 uvm_reg_block 还没有被 lock
* 检查此 memory 是已经加入到此 uvm_reg_block 中，避免重复加入
* 向 mems 数组中插入一条记录，记录的索引是要加入的 uvm_mem 的指针，而内容则是 id。**id 中记录了所有已经加入到 register model 中的 uvm_reg 和 uvm_mem 的数量。**

```systemverilog
local int unsigned  mems[uvm_mem];
```
  
```systemverilog
function void uvm_reg_block::add_mem(uvm_mem mem);
   if (this.is_locked()) begin
      `uvm_error("RegModel", "Cannot add memory to locked block model");
      return;
   end

   if (this.mems.exists(mem)) begin
      `uvm_error("RegModel", {"Memory '",mem.get_name(),
         "' has already been registered with block '",get_name(),"'"})
       return;
   end
   mems[mem] = id++;
endfunction: add_mem
```

text:
reset

* 当一个 register model 被集成到验证平台后，必须进行 reset 操作，这样才能保证 每个寄存器的值等于我们设置的初始值。register model并不会自动的进行 reset 操作，必须显式的调用 reset 函数进行复位操作。
* 遍历其中的每一个 uvm_reg, 调用[uvm_reg:reset](https://github.com/jiru1997/VLSI-Design-verification-interview/blob/main/VLSI%20Design%20Verification/Functional%20Verification/UVM1.2%20source%20code%20analysis/11%3A%20uvm_reg/chapter%2003%3A%20uvm_reg.md)
* 递归调用所有子 uvm_reg_block 的 [reset]() 函数，而子 uvm_reg_block 的 reset 函数又会调用所有加入其中的 uvm_reg 的 reset 函数。
```systemverilog
function void uvm_reg_block::reset(string kind = "HARD");

   foreach (regs[rg_]) begin
     uvm_reg rg = rg_;
     rg.reset(kind);
   end

   foreach (blks[blk_]) begin
     uvm_reg_block blk = blk_;
     blk.reset(kind);
   end
endfunction
```

```systemverilog
function void uvm_reg_block::set_default_hdl_path(string kind);

  if (kind == "") begin

           "Must specify a valid HDL abstraction (kind)"})

    kind = parent.get_default_hdl_path();
  end

  default_hdl_path = kind;
endfunction
```

text:
new

* 检查输入的 n_bits 的合法性，保证一个 memory 的单元的位宽至少为 1。
* 经过赋值后，m_size 存放的就是此 memory 一共有多少个单元，而 m_n_bits 则表示每个单元的数量，m_max_size 表示系统中所有 memory 中最大的位宽

   ```
   +--------------------+
   |    my_mem          |
   |                    |
   | m_size = 1024      |
   | m_n_bits = 32      |
   |                    |
   | +----------------+ |
   | |  Address 0     | |
   | | [31:0] 32 bits | |
   | +----------------+ |
   | |  Address 1     | |
   | | [31:0] 32 bits | |
   | +----------------+ |
   | |      ...       | |
   | |      ...       | |
   | +----------------+ |
   | |  Address 1023  | |
   | | [31:0] 32 bits | |
   | +----------------+ |
   |                    |
   +--------------------+
   ```

* 内部变量
  * m_size => 存放的就是此 memory 一共有多少个单元
  * m_n_bits => 表示每个单元的数量
  * m_max_size => 这里表示系统中所有 memory 中最大的位宽

```systemverilog
function uvm_mem::new (string           name,
                       longint unsigned size,
                       int unsigned     n_bits,
                       string           access = "RW",
                       int              has_coverage = UVM_NO_COVERAGE);

   super.new(name);
   m_locked = 0;
   if (n_bits == 0) begin
      `uvm_error("RegModel", {"Memory '",get_full_name(),"' cannot have 0 bits"})
      n_bits = 1;
   end
   m_size      = size;
   m_n_bits    = n_bits;
   m_backdoor  = null;
   m_access    = access.toupper();
   m_has_cover = has_coverage;
   m_hdl_paths_pool = new("hdl_paths");

   if (n_bits > m_max_size)
      m_max_size = n_bits;

endfunction: new
```

source_file: /tools/Synopsys/temp/uvm-source-code-1.2-knowledge-mcp/private/notes/UVM1.2 source code analysis_副本/12: uvm_tlm2/chapter 02: uvm_tlm2_generic_payload.md

text:
uvm_tlm_response_status_e

* **UVM_TLM_OK_RESPONSE (1)**:
  * **Meaning**: The operation completed successfully.
  * **Usage**: This is returned when a transaction is processed without any issues.

* **UVM_TLM_INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE (0)**:
  * **Meaning**: The transaction was not delivered to the target.
  * **Usage**: This might be used when a transaction fails to reach its intended destination.

* **UVM_TLM_GENERIC_ERROR_RESPONSE (-1)**:
  * **Meaning**: A generic error occurred.
  * **Usage**: This is a catch-all for errors that don't fit into more specific categories.

* **UVM_TLM_ADDRESS_ERROR_RESPONSE (-2)**:
  * **Meaning**: The transaction had an invalid address.
  * **Usage**: This is returned when the address specified in the transaction is not valid or out of range.

* **UVM_TLM_COMMAND_ERROR_RESPONSE (-3)**:
  * **Meaning**: The transaction had an invalid command.
  * **Usage**: This is used when the command (e.g., read, write) specified in the transaction is not recognized or not allowed.

* **UVM_TLM_BURST_ERROR_RESPONSE (-4)**:
  * **Meaning**: The transaction had an invalid burst.
  * **Usage**: This is returned when there's an issue with burst transactions, such as an invalid burst length or type.

* **UVM_TLM_BYTE_ENABLE_ERROR_RESPONSE (-5)**:
  * **Meaning**: The transaction had invalid byte enabling.
  * **Usage**: This is used when there's an issue with the byte enable signals in the transaction.


```systemverilog
typedef enum
{
    UVM_TLM_OK_RESPONSE = 1,                  // Operation completed successfully
    UVM_TLM_INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE = 0,          // Transaction not delivered to target
    UVM_TLM_GENERIC_ERROR_RESPONSE = -1,      // Generic error
    UVM_TLM_ADDRESS_ERROR_RESPONSE = -2,      // Invalid address
    UVM_TLM_COMMAND_ERROR_RESPONSE = -3,      // Invalid command
    UVM_TLM_BURST_ERROR_RESPONSE = -4,        // Invalid burst
    UVM_TLM_BYTE_ENABLE_ERROR_RESPONSE = -5   // Invalid byte enabling
} uvm_tlm_response_status_e;
```

text:
UVM_TLM_NB_TRANSPORT_FW_IMP

* Wraps forward path call function nb_transport_fw()
* Marks timing points for transaction execution
* Handles null delay error

```systemverilog
`define UVM_TLM_NB_TRANSPORT_FW_IMP(imp, T, P, t, p, delay)              \
  function uvm_tlm_sync_e nb_transport_fw(T t, ref P p, input uvm_tlm_time delay);  \
    if (delay == null) begin \
       `uvm_error("UVM/TLM/NULLDELAY", \
                  {get_full_name(), \
                   ".nb_transport_fw() called with 'null' delay"}) \
       return UVM_TLM_COMPLETED; \
    end \
    return imp.nb_transport_fw(t, p, delay);                          \
  endfunction
```

text:
UVM_TLM_B_TRANSPORT_IMP

* used to implement the blocking transport interface in TLM2 (Transaction Level Modeling 2) for UVM. Key points:
  * It defines a b_transport task for executing blocking transactions.
  * Checks for null delay and reports an error if found.
  * Calls the actual implementation of b_transport on the specified object.

```systemverilog
`define UVM_TLM_B_TRANSPORT_IMP(imp, T, t, delay)                        \
  task b_transport(T t, uvm_tlm_time delay);                              \
    if (delay == null) begin \
       `uvm_error("UVM/TLM/NULLDELAY", \
                  {get_full_name(), \
                   ".b_transport() called with 'null' delay"}) \
       return; \
    end \
    imp.b_transport(t, delay);                                        \
  endtask
```
